title: callista oculata
intro: Callista oculata, commonly known as the eye shell, is a marine snail shell used in traditional medicine. It is believed to have health benefits due to its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and possess antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Callista oculata are attributed to its ability to relax the muscles, reduce inflammation, and improve blood flow. The bioactive constituents present in Callista oculata include glycosaminoglycans and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
